title: Rav Yosef bar Avdimi

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 8a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.8a.12): he recited the baraita’s words “and the Sages prohibit”; Rav Nachman said, “The halakhah follows the Sages.” Hyman infers that he lived in Rav Nachman’s time.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage names Rav Nachman and preserves two versions. In one, the Sages prohibit and Rav Nachman rules in accordance with them; in the other, they permit and he rules against their opinion.
[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2017&lang=en) cites the same folio. Hyman quotes the first version.
